cases.name: R1 local unknown keys
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: local
    hooks:
    -   id: echo1
        name: echo1
        entry: echo
        language: system
        zzz: 1
        foo: 2
logs: WARNING
Unexpected key(s) present on local => echo1: foo, zzz

cases.name: R3 language_version on system
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: local
    hooks:
    -   id: lv
        name: lv
        entry: echo
        language: system
        language_version: python3
logs: ERROR
The hook `lv` specifies `language_version` but is using language `unsupported` which does not install an environment.  Perhaps you meant to use a specific language?

cases.name: R3 additional_dependencies on script
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: local
    hooks:
    -   id: ad
        name: ad
        entry: echo
        language: script
        additional_dependencies: [x]
logs: ERROR
The hook `ad` specifies `additional_dependencies` but is using language `unsupported_script` which does not install an environment.  Perhaps you meant to use a specific language?

cases.name: R4 default_language_version on unsupported
cases.config:
default_language_version: {unsupported: x}

-   repo: local
    hooks:
    -   id: s
        name: s
        entry: echo
        language: system
logs: ERROR
The hook `s` specifies `language_version` but is using language `unsupported` which does not install an environment.  Perhaps you meant to use a specific language?

repos:

cases.name: R6 manifest and config unknown keys
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: https://example.com/r
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: hello
        bar: 1
cases.manifest: - {id: hello, name: hello, entry: echo, language: system, foo: 1, stages: [commit, push, manual, commit]}
logs: WARNING
Unexpected key(s) present on https://example.com/r => hello: bar, foo

cases.config:

-   repo: https://example.com/r
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: h
        stages: []
        args: [--x]
        language: system
        name: renamed
cases.manifest: - {id: h, name: h, entry: echo, language: python, stages: [merge-commit], args: [--y, --z], types: [python]}

cases.name: language_version on an env-less override
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: https://example.com/r
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: h
        language: system
cases.manifest: - {id: h, name: h, entry: echo, language: python, language_version: python3.11}
logs: ERROR
The hook `h` specifies `language_version` but is using language `unsupported` which does not install an environment.  Perhaps you meant to use a specific language?

cases.name: every key overridden
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: https://example.com/r
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: h
        name: n2
        entry: e2
        alias: al
        files: '^a'
        exclude: '^b'
        types: [text]
        types_or: [python, rust]
        exclude_types: [binary]
        additional_dependencies: [dep==1]
        args: [--x]
        always_run: true
        fail_fast: true
        pass_filenames: false
        description: d2
        language_version: python3.12
        log_file: out.log
        minimum_pre_commit_version: '1.0'
        require_serial: true
        stages: [commit, manual]
        verbose: true
cases.manifest: - {id: h, name: h, entry: echo, language: python}

cases.name: language override changes the default_language_version lookup
cases.config:
default_language_version: {node: "18.0.0", python: python3.12}
repos:
-   repo: https://example.com/r
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: h
        language: node
cases.manifest: - {id: h, name: h, entry: echo, language: python}

cases.name: meta defaults and stages
cases.config:

repos:
-   repo: meta
    hooks:
    -   id: identity
        args: [--foo]
    -   id: check-useless-excludes
        stages: [manual]

cases.name: E1 unknown id
cases.config:
repos:
-   repo: https://example.com/r
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: nonexistent
cases.manifest: - {id: hello, name: hello, entry: echo, language: system}
logs: ERROR
`nonexistent` is not present in repository https://example.com/r.  Typo? Perhaps it is introduced in a newer version?  Often `pre-commit autoupdate` fixes this.

cases.name: remote repo: every _hook before any Hook.create

    -   id: b

The hook `c` specifies `language_version` but is using language `pygrep` which does not install an environment.  Perhaps you meant to use a specific language?
